statements.text: Le réseau no dey work again
La pluie don spoil the road
Madame sell me tchop quick quick
Gendarme stop the car for contrôle
Étudiant dey wait for quartier bus
Le prix be too much oh
Moto dey go fast for road
This taxi and that bendskin dey wait for quartier
Madame sell tchop and drink for road
